title: Fails to add RSS feed
summary: I put in https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/ to subscribe to. It failed to find the RSS feed. I put in https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/rss as that’s the exact RSS feed. It still failed. It seems that adding RSS feeds is broken.
body_markdown:
[Avi](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Avi)


September 25, 2026, 8:39pm 1


I put in[https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/](https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/) to subscribe to. It failed to find the RSS feed.


I put in[https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/rss](https://upsilandre.over-blog.com/rss) as that’s the exact RSS feed. It still failed.


It seems that adding RSS feeds is broken.


[steanne](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/steanne)


September 26, 2026, 1:53am 2


it adds just fine. it then shows


> This site has not been fetched in **5 hours** and is throwing errors.


when i check the actual error, it’s been returning 505 since july. when i look at the actual articles in the feed, the most recent one is


> Les Ghouls’n Ghosts
> January 31, 2025, 4:59 AM


and that’s the most recent article on the actual website, too. i think this site is defunct.
the rss feed is definitely broken on their end and the last blog content was almost two years ago.


[sergiomarchesini](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/sergiomarchesini)


October 15, 2026, 6:19pm 3


Same problem with[https://djayesse.over-blog.com/rss](https://djayesse.over-blog.com/rss)


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


October 16, 2026, 4:17pm 4


Both RSS feeds are valid. They load locally, but connections from NewsBlur’s servers to OverBlog time out before any response comes back. The 505 shown in NewsBlur means a timeout.


Upsilandre’s latest post is January 2025, but its feed still works. Djayesse is actively publishing, with a post from October 11. This is a connectivity problem between NewsBlur and OverBlog. I’m not sure why it’s timing out but it works locally, so likely they are blocking NewsBlur.
